Context

Letterpress is a turn-based word game developed by Loren Brichter and published by Atebits, released for iOS on 24 October 2012. Players claim letter tiles on a 5 × 5 grid; claimed tiles take the player’s color (Wikipedia)).

“For graphics and the user interface, he took inspiration from the Windows Phone.”

It won a 2013 Apple Design Award, and “Apple designer Jony Ive took inspiration from minimalist iOS apps, among them Letterpress, while designing graphics for iOS 7.”

The Verge described the interface as “barren” with “natural-feeling animations”.

Why it belongs

It shows the flat grammar moving from Microsoft to Apple’s platform through a third-party app, before iOS 7.
